tables.markdown:
| Layer | Question | Mainly responsible | Basis for judgment | Common mix-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Requirements decision | For this input, what behavior counts as correct? | Requirements owner, domain lead | Recorded decisions and examples; open questions and who owns them | Letting an agent's output or a test author's guess stand in for a decision |
| Candidate acceptance | Did this artifact do it? | QA owner, reviewer | An oracle checked with positive and negative controls, the actual acceptance result for this candidate's version, and a record of the operating conditions | Treating exit 0, "all tests pass" or byte-for-byte identity with a template as meeting the contract |
| Method comparison | Is this brief worth reusing? | EM (engineering manager) / Staff and the maintainer | A comparison result obtained under a scope and units fixed in advance, checked for effect, cost, effort and limits | Inferring a team default from one success or one set of full passes |

| Rule | Example | Question | Who decides |
|---|---|---|---|
| The date column is output in the specified format | A row with a date converts normally | When the date is missing, output an empty field or reject the whole input? | Export feature owner (undecided) |
| Preserve input row order and duplicate rows | Two identical rows are both kept | None | Already required by the caller (decided) |
| Field contents stay as they are | A name containing a comma; a note containing a line break | May each record end with either LF or CRLF? | Requirements owner and QA owner confirm together |

| `text` on line 1 | R05 verdict | Counts as a message? | Exit at EOF | Legacy end summary appended? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `" "` (whitespace only) | Valid; printed unchanged and flushed | Yes | 0 | No |
| `null` | Not printed | No | 5 (completed but no message) | Yes |
| `false` | Malformed; one diagnostic emitted | No | 6 (malformed present) | No |
| `123` | Malformed; one diagnostic emitted | No | 6 (malformed present) | No |

| What regression testing checks | What is held fixed, what changes | What it can tell you |
|---|---|---|
| Grader | Hold the verified positive and negative control fixtures constant; change the grader version | Does the new yardstick wrongly reject legitimate behavior, or miss a known fault? |
| A new candidate implementation | Hold the same contract cases constant; check the new candidate | Does this candidate still meet the requirements the checks cover? |
| Model / harness delivery method | Obtain new generation results; record the task/trial distribution and the policy version | Has the new version of the method regressed on this batch of work? |

| Output | Physical lines / records | Accept anything that parses | Byte-identical to the CRLF template | Check header and ordered records |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Legitimate, CRLF | 5 / 3 | Accept | Accept | Accept |
| Legitimate, LF | 5 / 3 | Accept | Reject | Accept |
| Duplicates removed | 4 / 2 | Accept | Reject | Reject |
| Header column order wrong | 5 / 3 | Accept | Reject | Reject |
| Data row order wrong | 5 / 3 | Accept | Reject | Reject |
| One date value wrong | 5 / 3 | Accept | Reject | Reject |

| Effect verdict | Pre-set condition | Hypothetical interval (percentage points) | What can be claimed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supports exceeding the practical threshold | L > +5 | [+6, +9] | Under the specified method and assumptions, supports an improvement above 5 percentage points; adoption is supported only if cost and effort also meet their conditions |
| Rules out an improvement reaching the threshold | U < +5 | [+1, +4] or [−2, +3] | Rules out an improvement of at least 5 percentage points; the former still supports a smaller positive improvement, and neither amounts to equivalence |
| Still undecided | L ≤ +5 and U ≥ +5 | [+2, +8] or [−1, +7] | Can neither support adoption nor rule out an improvement reaching the threshold |
